🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; Energy, Utilities and Industrials are leading while Technology and Communication are weak, providing mixed signals and justifying the neutral call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +7.36% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials also positive: LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -4.87% | 1M: +2.04%) CORRECTION. Communication weak: TMUS (1W: -11.63% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary poor: TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -6.49% | 1M: -0.19%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND; LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND; HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +8.44% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (top performers from Utilities, Industrials, Materials).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND; ISRG (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -17.65%) BELOW TREND; TMUS (1W: -11.63% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -11.60% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND; SHOP (1W: -10.44% | 1M: +4.01%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in large-cap tech and select growth names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND; watch FCX (1W: +8.44% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY for short-term reversal rather than durable breakout.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is under pressure and mixed with many short-term hits: NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -4.87% | 1M: +2.04%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND. Sector-level 1W: -3.49% (24 stocks) — internal rotation and earnings/news-driven dispersion.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed/soft on the week: JPM (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, BAC (news positive) but sector 1W: -1.70% (20 stocks) shows uneven internals; style: cyclical/value signals present but not broad enough to shift regime.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare shows selective strength: JNJ (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +8.44%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +7.12%) ABOVE TREND, but ISRG (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -17.65%) BELOW TREND highlights dispersion; sector 1W: -0.77% (17 stocks) — defensive features but mixed.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Energy and select Industrials/Utilities given current leadership; reduce exposure to lagging large-cap Communication and weak Consumer Discretionary names. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt (energy/industrial leadership) while keeping size risk in check due to narrow concentration.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND; META (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION — watch for follow-through.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +12.15%) — sector strength to monitor for continuation. BEARISH: Communication (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -3.77%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -4.53% | 1M: -2.82%) — watch for further weakness and earnings/news fallout.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
XOM near continuation zone: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND — monitor firming above near-term highs. GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND — watch for failure to reclaim short-term support as a sign of deeper correction. NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND — watch for resumption above recent consolidation for tech sentiment inflection.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
EA (+90): EU clears PIF acquisition — price action: confirming if EA is rallying (check intraday); positive M&A catalyst. TMO (+80): Thermo Fisher raises outlook — TMO (1W data not listed above) sentiment confirmed by upgraded guidance; watch stock for continued strength. LMT (+60): Lockheed Martin beat-and-raise — LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (-45): WSJ headline on China memory chips friction — AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION — news aligns with near-term weakness (divergence vs 1M). DHR (-50): Danaher post-earnings selloff — DHR status not listed above but treat as confirming recent weakness. ORCL (-40): Skepticism on AI spend payoff — ORCL (news bearish) requires watching for price confirmation or distribution.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy/Industrials/Utilities leadership and shallow breadth (Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive). XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND and LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND and TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND are key weakness. Key risk: narrow/concentrated leadership and large-cap tech drawdowns alongside mixed bullish/bearish news signals — monitor for trend confirmation or widening divergence.
